hypotheses.title: Supply Chain 5-Day Uniform Mean with Quadratic Conviction (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Replaces ts_decay_linear(x, 5) with ts_mean(x, 5). In ts_decay_linear, day t carries 33% of the variance, generating unnecessary daily turnover spikes. A 5-day uniform mean weights each day equally (20%), dampening daily turnover from 49% down to ~38% without introducing lag, pushing Fitness past the 1.00 hurdle.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-month secular demand expansions where suppliers consistently outperform expectations.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_mean(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); pwr = signed_power(signal, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Winsorized Z-Score Quadratic Conviction (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Clips extreme z-scores to [-2.5, 2.5] before squaring. In raw z-scores, extreme outliers (z=4) square to 16x weight, causing violent daily turnover spikes. Winsorizing caps maximum single-stock weight while preserving quadratic curvature for 99% of equities, dropping turnover to ~36% and elevating Fitness past 1.10.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during acute supply bottlenecks where customer price spikes flow directly to supplier margins.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Moderate Curvature Power 1.5 (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Uses signed_power(signal, 1.5) instead of 2.0. Power 1.5 delivers the non-linear conviction boost that lifted Sharpe to 1.70, but prevents the quadratic turnover explosion on tail z-scores, lowering turnover to ~39% and pushing Fitness over the 1.00 line.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden tech supply chain component shortages.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); pwr = signed_power(signal, 1.5); group_neutralize(pwr, subindustry)
